t: A security-focused RISC-V microcontroller with most of its chip design published openly.
steps: Order the Dabao board from Crowd Supply. It launched at about 9.50 US dollars.
Get a USB-C cable to connect it to your computer.
Choose a path. Use the Dabao C SDK for plain C or Xous for Rust.
Install a RISC-V GCC toolchain for C, or Rust with the Xous VS Code extension.
Build the blink example from the Dabao C SDK.
Copy the signed UF2 file to the board over USB.
Try the BIO examples next, using the bio-sim simulator first.
meta: Wild Open. From $9.50. A few stores.
